title: Route source work out of the ordinary product journey
when: When a command is source-dev/admin, a source checkout is being maintained or an internal contract needs inspection.
need: Identify the contributor/operator audience and exact source-development authority before rendering, direct execution, schema operations or release maintenance.
surface: Source doctrine; generated agents/packets; dev/schema/scratch/source-authority and runner-fleet helpers
gap: These command families must be accounted for without presenting them as normal first-user prerequisites. Review question: which public stubs should route to the final contributor homes after reorganization?
